actions.name: create_membership

Create a membership. Ensures an active membership for the given email will be provisioned.

- If the user already exists, they will be added to the requestor's organization.
- If it doesn't exist, a new user will be provisioned.

As a security precaution, this operation requires the organization to have the

A list of Lead Custom Field IDs that define which leads user with this role can see. If the role has `view_all_leads` permission, this field should be empty.
